topic_ko: 로미오와 줄리엣 효과 — 사라질지 모른다고 느끼면 더 원하게 되는 심리와 한정 판매

passage: Romeo and Juliet knew each other for only five days, yet they fell deeply in love.
One psychologist thinks the problems they faced made their love stronger.
Because their parents tried to keep them apart, they wanted each other even more.
Interestingly, the same feeling appears when we go shopping.
We tend to want something more when we think we might lose the chance to have it.
Sellers use this by saying things like “Only three days left!”
Worried about missing out, buyers often purchase the item immediately.
So when you see a limited-time sale, it is wise to ask whether you truly need the item.
choices: how parents can help their children make good friends
why Romeo and Juliet’s story has stayed popular for centuries
the reasons sellers offer large discounts on old products
how fear of losing something makes people want it more
the best ways to plan a shopping budget
theme.explanation_ko: 방해를 받거나 기회를 잃을 것 같을 때 더 원하게 되는 심리가 사랑과 쇼핑 모두에 나타난다는 글이므로 ④가 주제이다.
theme.distractor_ko: ① 친구 사귀기는 무관하다. ② 이야기가 인기 있는 이유는 다루지 않는다. ③ 할인 폭이 아니라 기간 제한이 핵심이다. ⑤ 예산 계획은 나오지 않는다.

passage: Romeo and Juliet fell in love in just five days.
A psychologist explains that their many problems actually brought them closer.
Their parents’ attempts to stop them only made the two want each other more.
This feeling also affects how we shop.
When people fear that something will soon disappear, they want it even more.
That is why sellers shout, “Only three days left! Buy before it’s gone!”
Afraid of missing out, buyers rush to purchase right away.
This is known as the Romeo and Juliet effect.
Next time you see a “3-day-only sale,” stop and ask yourself whether you really need it.
choices: 진정한 사랑은 오랜 시간에 걸쳐 천천히 자란다.
부모는 자녀의 연애에 간섭하지 않아야 한다.
기간 한정 세일은 소비자에게 큰 이익을 준다.
판매자는 소비자에게 정직한 정보를 제공해야 한다.
사라질지 모른다고 느끼면 더 원하게 되므로, 한정 판매 앞에서는 정말 필요한지 따져 봐야 한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 사라질 것 같으면 더 원하는 로미오와 줄리엣 효과를 설명하고, 한정 세일을 보면 정말 필요한지 스스로 물으라고 하므로 ⑤가 요지이다.
gist.distractor_ko: ① 둘은 5일 만에 사랑에 빠졌다. ② 부모의 간섭은 예시일 뿐 주장이 아니다. ③ 오히려 충동구매를 경계한다. ④ 판매자의 정직성은 다루지 않는다.

passage: Romeo and Juliet knew each other for only five days, yet they fell deeply in love.
One psychologist thinks the problems they faced made their love stronger.
Because their parents tried to keep them apart, they wanted each other even more.
Interestingly, the same feeling appears when we go shopping.
We tend to want something more when we think we might lose the chance to have it.
Sellers use this by saying things like “Only three days left!”
Worried about missing out, buyers often purchase the item immediately.
So when you see a limited-time sale, it is wise to ask whether you truly need the item.
choices: Love Grows Slowly over Many Years
Hard to Get, Harder to Resist
Parents Always Know What Is Best
How to Write a Great Love Story
title.explanation_ko: 얻기 어렵거나 잃을 것 같을수록 더 끌린다는 사랑과 쇼핑의 공통 심리를 담은 ②가 제목으로 알맞다.
title.distractor_ko: ① 5일 만에 사랑에 빠졌다. ③ 부모의 판단을 다루지 않는다. ④ 할인 폭이 아니라 기간 제한이 핵심이다. ⑤ 글쓰기 방법이 아니다.

passage: Romeo and Juliet had known each other for only five days.
Still, they loved each other so much that they chose to die rather than live apart.
A psychologist believes their many problems made their love grow faster.
When their parents tried to stop them, the couple wanted each other even more.
The same thing happens in stores.
A sign saying “Buy before it’s gone!” makes shoppers feel that the chance is slipping away.
Worried about not getting what they want, they buy right away.
So, before you join the rush, ask yourself: Do I really need it?
choices: they may soon be unable to get the item
the price of the item will go up tomorrow
the store is too crowded to shop in
they have already spent too much money
the item is not as good as it looks
implication.explanation_ko: “사라지기 전에 사세요!”라는 문구 때문에 곧 그 물건을 살 수 없게 될 것 같다고 느낀다는 뜻이므로 ①이 알맞다.
implication.distractor_ko: ② 가격 인상, ③ 혼잡, ④ 지출, ⑤ 품질은 본문에서 말하지 않았다.

passage: Did you know that Romeo and Juliet knew each other for only five days?
A psychologist has an idea about why they fell in love so quickly.
The idea is that they liked each other more because they had many problems.
Their parents tried stop them, which made them want each other even more.
This feeling also applies to shopping.
Shoppers want an item more when they think it might disappear.
Worried about not getting what they want, buyers often buy right away.
This tendency is known as the Romeo and Juliet effect.
grammar.explanation_ko: try 는 to부정사를 목적어로 취해 ‘~하려고 애쓰다’를 나타내므로 tried stop 은 tried to stop 이 되어야 한다.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 간접의문문 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」. ② 보어 자리의 명사절 that. ④ 단수 주어 This feeling 에 맞는 applies. ⑤ 전치사 about 뒤 동명사의 부정 not getting 과 관계대명사 what.

passage: Romeo and Juliet’s love story is a very sad one.
They knew each other for only five days, but they fell deeply in love.
A psychologist says their many problems made them like each other more.
When their parents tried to stop them, they wanted each other even more.
This feeling is not only about love; it also applies to shopping.
People want something less when they think it might disappear.
Sellers take advantage of this by saying, “Only three days left!”
Worried about missing out, buyers purchase the item right away.
vocab.explanation_ko: 사라질지 모른다고 생각하면 그것을 ‘더’ 원하게 되므로 less 는 more 가 되어야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ① 많은 ‘문제’ 때문에 더 좋아했다. ② 부모는 둘을 ‘막으려’ 했다. ③ 이 감정이 쇼핑에도 ‘적용된다’. ⑤ 놓칠까 봐 ‘즉시’ 산다.

passage: Romeo and Juliet’s parents tried to keep the two apart.
Strangely, this only made the young lovers want each other more.
Shoppers often react in a similar way.
When a sign says “Only three days left!” people suddenly feel they must buy.
Afraid of missing their chance, they purchase the item right away.
In both cases, people tend to want something more when ______________________.
This is called the Romeo and Juliet effect.
So, before you buy, ask yourself whether you really need it.
choices: it is cheaper than they expected
they have plenty of time to decide
it seems hard to keep or get
blank.explanation_ko: 부모의 반대로 함께 있기 어려웠던 연인, 곧 끝나는 세일 앞의 쇼핑객 모두 ‘지키거나 얻기 어려워 보일 때’ 더 원하게 된다.
blank.distractor_ko: ③ 시간이 넉넉하면 오히려 서두르지 않는다. ① 가격, ② 친구, ④ 전문가 추천은 본문과 무관하다.

irrelevant.intro: Romeo and Juliet wanted each other even more because their parents tried to stop their love.
sentences: A psychologist says this feeling is not just about love but also applies to shopping.
Shakespeare wrote many other famous plays, including Hamlet and Macbeth.
People tend to want something more when they think it might disappear.
Sellers use this idea by saying, “Only three days left! Buy before it’s gone!”
Worried about not getting what they want, buyers often purchase the item right away.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: ②는 셰익스피어의 다른 작품 소개로, 사라질 것 같으면 더 원하는 심리를 다루는 글의 흐름과 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ① 사랑 → 쇼핑으로의 연결, ③ 핵심 심리, ④ 판매자의 이용, ⑤ 구매자의 반응으로 모두 흐름에 맞다.

order.given: Romeo and Juliet knew each other for only five days, yet they fell in love. A psychologist has an idea about why their love grew so quickly.

blocks.A: This feeling is not just about love; it also applies to shopping. People want something more when they think it might go away.
blocks.B: According to the psychologist, they liked each other more because they had many problems. Their parents tried to stop them, and this made them want each other even more.
blocks.C: That is why sellers say, “Only three days left! Buy before it’s gone!” Worried about missing out, buyers purchase the item right away.

order.explanation_ko: 심리학자의 생각이 있다(주어진 글) → 그 생각의 내용: 문제가 많아 더 좋아했다(B) → 이 감정은 쇼핑에도 적용된다(A) → 그래서 판매자가 “단 3일 남았습니다!”라고 한다(C) 순이다.
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 the psychologist 는 주어진 글의 A psychologist 를 받고, (A)의 This feeling 은 (B)의 감정을, (C)의 That is why 는 (A)의 쇼핑 심리를 받는다.

insert.insert_sentence: How could two people fall in love so quickly?

passage_marked.text: Romeo and Juliet knew each other for only five days.
A psychologist believes the problems they faced made their feelings grow faster.
Their parents tried to stop them, which only made them want each other more.
This feeling also applies to shopping, because people want things more when they might disappear.
That is why sellers say, “Only three days left!”

insert.explanation_ko: ‘단 5일’이라는 사실 뒤에 ‘어떻게 그렇게 빨리 사랑에 빠질 수 있었을까?’라는 질문이 오고, 이어서 심리학자의 설명이 그 답이 되므로 ①이 알맞다.
insert.distractor_ko: ② 이후에는 이미 빨리 사랑에 빠진 이유가 설명된 뒤라 질문이 어색하다. ④⑤ 뒤는 쇼핑 이야기라 연결되지 않는다.

passage: Romeo and Juliet fell in love in just five days.
A psychologist explains that their many problems actually brought them closer.
Their parents’ attempts to stop them only made the two want each other more.
This feeling also affects how we shop.
When people fear that something will soon disappear, they want it even more.
That is why sellers shout, “Only three days left! Buy before it’s gone!”
Afraid of missing out, buyers rush to purchase right away.
This is known as the Romeo and Juliet effect.
Next time you see a “3-day-only sale,” stop and ask yourself whether you really need it.
summary.summary_template: When people feel that something might soon __(A)__, they want it more, so sellers use time __(B)__ to make buyers act quickly.
summary.explanation_ko: 곧 ‘사라질’(disappear) 것 같으면 더 원하므로, 판매자는 ‘시간 제한’(time limits, 단 3일)을 이용해 즉시 사게 만든다.
summary.distractor_ko: ①④⑤ 좋아짐·나타남·변화가 아니라 사라짐이 핵심이다. ② 시간 ‘시험’이 아니라 시간 ‘제한’이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.explanation_ko: 시간의 접속사 when 뒤에 「주어 + 동사」, think 뒤에 that 이 생략된 명사절 it might go away 가 온다.
writing.answer: People want something more when they think it might go away.
writing.ko_prompt: 사람들은 무언가가 사라질지도 모른다고 생각할 때 그것을 더 원한다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 우리말을 영작하시오.
conditions: 관계대명사 which 의 계속적 용법을 쓸 것
writing.explanation_ko: , which 는 앞 절 전체(부모가 막으려 한 것)를 받고, 사역동사 made 뒤에 목적어 Romeo and Juliet 과 동사원형 want 가 온다.
writing.answer: Their parents did not like their love and tried to stop them, which made Romeo and Juliet want each other even more.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들의 부모는 그들의 사랑을 좋아하지 않았고 그들을 막으려고 했는데, 이것이 로미오와 줄리엣이 서로를 훨씬 더 원하게 만들었다.

writing.question: 본문의 내용에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 한 단어를 쓰시오.
writing.context: Sellers say “Only three days left!” because buyers ___________ about not getting what they want and buy right away.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문 14번 문장의 Buyers worry about not getting what they want 에서 찾는다.

writing.question: 다음 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.explanation_ko: not just A, but also B ‘A뿐만 아니라 B도’, apply to ‘~에 적용되다’.
writing.en_prompt: This feeling is not just about love, but it also applies to shopping.
writing.answer: 이 감정은 단지 사랑에 관한 것만이 아니라, 쇼핑에도 적용된다.

writing.question: 본문을 한 문장으로 요약할 때 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.summary: Romeo and Juliet wanted each other more because their parents tried to __(A)__ them, and shoppers want items more when they think the items might __(B)__.
writing.explanation_ko: 본문 7번 문장의 tried to stop them, 10번 문장의 they might disappear 에서 찾는다.

writing.question: 다음 조건에 맞게 이 글의 주제문을 영어로 쓰시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 이 글의 주제를 한 문장으로 쓰시오.
conditions: disappear 와 want 를 반드시 포함할 것
writing.answer: People want something more when they think it might disappear, and sellers use this feeling.
writing.explanation_ko: 사라질 것 같으면 더 원하는 심리와 판매자의 활용을 한 문장에 담는다.
